name: io.github.romudille-bit/agentpay
description: Economic intelligence for AI agents: budget-capped x402 tool calls with verifiable receipts, 17 free crypto/data tools, and verified_route buyer-side trust routing across the x402 marketplace.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_BASE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional EVM private key for wallet mode: settle paid tools in-place (gasless EIP-3009 on Base). Keyless free-tools mode works without it.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTPAY_MAX_SPEND
environmentVariables.description: Hard per-session spend cap in USD when wallet mode is enabled (default 0.10).
